scope: 100 curated canonical sources, all with explicit native recipes and balance entries. The 36 selection proposals are retained separately as historical design evidence. This is a total selection, not 100 additional spells.
historical_proposal_scaling: Descriptive trait units start at 1. Amplify, range and area only affect values explicitly identified in each plan. Source rank and rarity never set native costs or power.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Electricity jumps between at most two creatures.

native.behavior: Arc to the aimed creature and at most one nearby enemy, dealing four HP to each.
native.adaptation: A visible four-block jump replaces independently selected Pathfinder targets; no Reflex save or heightening.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A targeted flame hits harder within melee reach and can leave a lingering burn.

native.behavior: Burn one aimed creature; six direct HP within three blocks, four farther away, plus a short burn.
native.adaptation: Melee reach gives a deterministic bonus; normal hits burn rather than using a critical-hit gate.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)

native.behavior: Chill an aimed creature for four HP and briefly weaken it.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)

native.adaptation: Three direct HP and brief Weakness replace acid dice and critical persistent damage; native damage is magic.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)

native.behavior: A narrow gust cuts at most two creatures in its path.

native.behavior: An aimed water spout damages and lifts up to three creatures.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)

native.behavior: An initial three-HP stone burst leaves a three-second slowing patch.
native.adaptation: A particle field replaces persistent solid rubble and difficult-terrain blocks; does not change terrain.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)

native.adaptation: Native magic impact plus vanilla Poison replaces poison dice and critical persistent damage; vanilla immunities apply to the status.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)

native.behavior: A three-second ward reduces the next incoming hit by three HP.
native.adaptation: Automatic one-hit reduction substitutes for AC, a chosen Shield Block reaction, and the tabletop recast lockout.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A brief exhalation damages creatures in a forward cone.

native.behavior: Breathe a short cone of fire into at most four enemies.
native.adaptation: A single native cone replaces saves and damage dice; burning is deterministic on contact.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Reliable force shards can be distributed among targets, with more shards for more actions.

native.behavior: Three homing force bolts deliver up to nine HP to an aimed enemy.
native.adaptation: Fixed three-bolt version replaces one/two/three-action options; native projectiles can miss or be blocked.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Pressurized water strikes and knocks a creature or unattended object backward.

native.behavior: A water jet deals seven HP and forcefully pushes one creature.
native.adaptation: Native velocity replaces fixed-grid push distance and critical doubling.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Dark tendrils strike living creatures along a line and cause bleeding.

native.behavior: A narrow void line damages four creatures at most, leaving brief lingering injuries.
native.adaptation: Wither replaces persistent bleed; eligible undead are excluded from void damage.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A distant lightning strike combines electrical and sonic damage; metal targets fare worse.

native.behavior: A thunderbolt deals nine HP and briefly weakens an aimed creature.
native.adaptation: One typed lightning impact replaces separate electricity/sonic rolls and critical clumsy/deafened conditions.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Magical fear weakens a creature and can force it to flee.

native.behavior: Frighten one enemy, reducing its melee strength and movement briefly.
native.adaptation: Weakness II and Slowness replace frightened values and critical fleeing; native AI does not run a fear state.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: The caster gains a substantial short-lived movement boost.

native.behavior: Gain Speed III for five seconds.
native.adaptation: Vanilla movement speed replaces the fixed tabletop speed bonus.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A reactive updraft slows a falling creature and prevents the affected fall's damage.

native.behavior: Gain five seconds of Slow Falling.
native.adaptation: A self buff replaces the falling-target reaction; must be cast before impact.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A willing creature receives a short-lived defensive ward.

native.behavior: Reduce four incoming hits by twenty percent within eight seconds.
native.adaptation: Percentage damage prevention replaces AC and saving-throw bonuses; no alignment filtering.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Undead-associated energies grant temporary extra resilience.

native.behavior: Gain four temporary absorption HP for eight seconds.
native.adaptation: Vanilla Absorption I replaces tabletop temporary HP; recasts follow vanilla status replacement instead of adding pools.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Mental reassurance heals a willing creature and fortifies its mental defenses.

native.behavior: Heal seven HP and remove Weakness from yourself.
native.adaptation: Self healing and removing Weakness replace touch healing and the mental-save bonus.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A targeted spell saps strength for a duration determined by resistance.

native.behavior: Weaken one creature’s melee attacks for six seconds.
native.adaptation: Weakness II replaces save-dependent enfeebled degrees; no damage.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A touched creature resists one selected form of elemental damage.

native.behavior: Halve six incoming fire hits within ten seconds.
native.adaptation: This baseline selects fire; acid/cold/electricity/sonic choices are deferred. Uses Minecraft fire damage tags.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A sustained flame moves under the caster's command and burns creatures it passes.

native.behavior: A fixed floating flame pulses fifteen direct HP over five seconds to each lingering enemy.
native.adaptation: A stationary field replaces sustained manual movement; no tabletop action-per-round sustain.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: An area of magical light dazzles creatures and defeats invisibility or concealment.

native.behavior: Reveal up to four creatures with Glowing and strip their invisibility.
native.adaptation: Glowing/short Weakness replace concealed, dazzled and blinded degrees; does not create a true anti-stealth perimeter.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A ghostly weapon echo attacks at range and can strike again when sustained.

native.behavior: A spirit weapon follows one target for ten one-and-a-half-HP strikes.
native.adaptation: A target-following field replaces attack rolls, a shaped weapon, and manual sustained attacks.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A chosen point erupts in a large fire blast.

native.behavior: A fireball bursts for fourteen direct HP and burning against up to five enemies.
native.adaptation: Native capped hostile-only blast differs from indiscriminate tabletop area damage; no terrain destruction.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Lightning damages creatures along a long straight line.

native.behavior: A narrow lightning line deals fourteen HP to up to five enemies.
native.adaptation: Native line and target cap replace Reflex saves and uncapped grid line; no terrain ignition.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A draining touch harms a living creature and grants temporary resilience from actual damage.

native.behavior: A close draining touch deals eight HP and grants four temporary HP if it causes health loss.
native.adaptation: Fixed Absorption I replaces temporary HP equal to half damage; it does not heal the caster. Undead are immune to the harmful drain.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A creature gains an extra action usable only to move or strike.

native.behavior: Gain Speed II and Haste II for eight seconds.
native.adaptation: Movement and mining speed replace a restricted extra action; no extra spell casts or attack timer bypass.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Time distortion reduces a creature's available actions.

native.behavior: Slow one creature’s movement and block work for five seconds.
native.adaptation: Slowness III and Mining Fatigue II replace action loss; casting channels are not automatically interrupted.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A sufficiently weak mindless undead becomes a minion; hostile treatment ends control.

native.behavior: Temporarily control one existing undead mob for eight seconds.
native.adaptation: Finite ownership replaces permanent obedience and spoken orders; players and native summons cannot be claimed. Existing AI follows/fights for the caster.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A sustained zone restores living creatures and damages undead each round.

native.behavior: A six-second life field heals living creatures and hurts undead each second.
native.adaptation: Indiscriminate living healing/undead damage is retained; no sustain action, restores HP rather than limbs.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Powerful ongoing regeneration repairs injury; acid or fire briefly suppresses it.

native.behavior: Regenerate twelve HP over eight seconds unless fire damage ends the effect.
native.adaptation: Fire permanently ends this cast; source acid suppression, regrowing anatomy and death prevention are simplified.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A fiery blocking shield protects from cold and can burn adjacent attackers.

native.behavior: An eight-second fire shield blocks three hits and burns nearby attackers, with limited freezing resistance.
native.adaptation: Automatic finite reactions replace choosing Shield Block and a physical held shield; only Minecraft freezing-tagged damage counts as cold.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Magical copies of a held weapon strike a cone or surrounding area.

native.behavior: A weapon storm sweeps up to five enemies with ten HP plus half the caster’s attack value.
native.adaptation: Uses one cone instead of a cone/burst selection; flat additive weapon context replaces dice-size multiplication.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A concentrated attack delivers a powerful hit to one creature's spirit.

native.behavior: A spiritual detonation strikes up to five enemies for sixteen HP.
native.adaptation: Native magic can strike ordinary living bodies; spirit-only interactions and possession-specific effects are deferred.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Lightning jumps through distinct creatures while line of effect remains valid.

native.behavior: Lightning jumps through up to six visible enemies for twelve HP each.
native.adaptation: A six-victim no-repeat chain replaces save-based chain continuation; each jump requires visibility.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Freezing darkness hits a large area, harming living creatures with void and potentially blinding.

native.behavior: An eclipse blast deals twenty HP and briefly blinds and weakens up to six enemies.
native.adaptation: One cold impact replaces cold plus void rolls; undead take the cold component, with no permanent blindness or darkness terrain.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A long freezing rift damages and slows victims; severe hits encase them in breakable ice.

native.behavior: A wide cold rift deals twenty-two HP and heavily slows at most six enemies.
native.adaptation: Freezing/Slowness replace enfeebling, slowed actions and exact line geometry; no physical terrain rift.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Four celestial impacts combine central blunt force and a chosen energy explosion without repeat overlap damage.

native.behavior: Channel twelve falling stars; each creature can take at most six five-HP impacts.
native.adaptation: Rain projectiles replace four independently located elemental bursts; shared hit caps prevent overlap multiplication.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A vast eruption combines several elemental disasters with terrain-dependent physical impacts.

native.behavior: Channel four elemental surges into one fixed area for up to thirty-two direct HP per creature.
native.adaptation: Four explicit native phases replace six simultaneous damage categories, massive terrain effects and flying-creature exceptions.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: A fragile glass defense blocks a hit, then shatters and can wound the nearby attacker.

native.behavior: A three-second glass ward blocks three HP once and lashes a nearby attacker for three HP.
native.adaptation: Automatic mitigation and magic retaliation replace raising/blocking a glass shield, saves, and critical shards; terrain is unchanged.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: The caster moves instantly to a visible open destination; a higher-rank version reaches previously visited distant locations.

native.behavior: Teleport to a visible dry, supported empty position within twenty blocks.
native.adaptation: Only local visible travel; loaded-space and collision validation can reject a paid cast. No distant memory destination or dimension transfer; arrival plays after success.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A small sustained image or simple sound can distract observers, who can recognize and disbelieve it.

native.behavior: A stationary four-second light-and-sound figment draws nearby hostile mobs toward its one-hit marker.
native.adaptation: A fixed wisp/lure replaces arbitrary images or sounds, skill checks and per-viewer disbelief. It deals no damage and can be struck to end it.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A sustained creature illusion can attack belief, disappears when struck, and stops harming observers who disbelieve it.

native.behavior: A stationary one-hit wolf-shaped decoy distracts hostile mobs for at most six seconds.
native.adaptation: Uses a silent inert vanilla wolf silhouette with no attacks; movement, belief damage and per-observer disbelief are omitted. The proxy is targetable, not a fully nonphysical image.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A creature becomes invisible until expiry or a completed hostile action; a higher-rank version survives hostile actions.

native.behavior: Stay invisible for eight seconds; dealing committed damage ends this cast and its two-tick refresh.
native.adaptation: Uses vanilla invisibility: armor/held items remain visible. Only committed damage ends the buff; failed swings and other hostile actions are not detected. External longer invisibility is not removed.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Slippery ground impairs footing; coating an object instead makes handling it difficult, with distinct held and worn effects.

native.behavior: A four-second patch slows and nudges up to three hostile creatures each half-second.
native.adaptation: Slowness and small caster-relative impulses approximate slippery footing. No prone state, real friction changes, object greasing or permanent blocks.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: A temporary layer of thick mud turns a ground area into difficult terrain.

native.behavior: A six-second mud patch strongly slows at most four hostile creatures, fading shortly after they leave.
native.adaptation: Slowness III approximates difficult terrain; existing blocks and actual friction are unchanged. A destructible marker owns the finite field.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Vital energy heals living recipients or harms undead; different casting lengths provide touch, ranged, and area versions.

native.behavior: A ranged vitality pulse heals one living creature for eight HP or harms undead for eight HP.
native.adaptation: One ranged form only; no action-count variants, area form, self fallback, saves or automatic heightening. Living enemies can be healed.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Void energy harms living recipients or heals undead; different casting lengths provide touch, ranged, and area versions.

native.behavior: A ranged void pulse heals undead for eight HP or harms one living creature for eight HP.
native.adaptation: One ranged form only; eligibility uses the undead tag rather than a tabletop negative-healing rule. No area/touch variants or automatic heightening.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A pulse reports nearby magic; higher ranks reveal strength and rough location, with restrictions on detecting deceptive illusions.

native.behavior: Privately report whether native manifestations or equipped enchanted items are within sixteen blocks.
native.adaptation: Presence only, from loaded native state/equipped items. It does not inspect other mods, inventories or blocks, reveal hidden locations, or unlock discovery/progression.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Extended object examination detects magic and assists identification; detecting deceptive illusions depends on their relative rank.

native.behavior: After two seconds of examination, privately report whether the currently held object is enchanted.
native.adaptation: Main-hand item at completion is the inspection target; only vanilla enchantment presence is recognized. No full item identification, stored discovery or observer-wide result.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: A rust cloud cuts occupants and obscures vision; rusting metal creatures can expand it and suffer lingering harm.

native.behavior: A five-second abrasive cloud deals at most ten direct HP per creature and briefly obscures four hostile occupants.
native.adaptation: Blindness approximates obscured sight. Metal-specific expansion/weakness and item rust are omitted; no durability or terrain changes.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: Fiery insects surround one creature; ant and firefly variants repeatedly combine damage with movement or vision impairment.

native.behavior: A following firefly swarm burns its captured creature for ten direct HP over five seconds and briefly blinds it.
native.adaptation: Only the firefly-inspired variant, with a breakable marker and fixed five pulses. The ant variant, insect models, saves and forced movement are omitted; nearby bystanders take no pulse damage.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A sustained animal ally fights for the caster, with stronger creature choices at higher ranks.

native.behavior: Summon one sixteen-HP allied wolf for twenty seconds; recasting dismisses it.
native.adaptation: A single curated vanilla wolf uses native ownership/follow/combat AI; no tabletop animal roster, source creature stats or automatic rank heightening.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Planar flickering reduces damage except force and repeatedly transports the caster a short distance in a random direction.

native.behavior: For six seconds, reduce four nonmagical hits by a quarter and attempt a short safe random teleport every two seconds.
native.adaptation: Native magical damage bypasses the finite mitigation, a broader exception than source force. Unsafe random destinations skip that pulse; no phased entity state or unseen geometry.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: A restorative breeze supports recovery and affliction resistance, eases heat, and heals living creatures that remain throughout its duration.

native.behavior: A six-second restorative field heals each living visitor six HP once after three seconds of uninterrupted sampled occupancy.
native.adaptation: A missing five-tick sample resets dwell; reentry cannot earn a second heal in the same cast. Undead are excluded; medical skill, affliction saves and temperature systems are omitted.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Creates solid stone in a chosen wall, bridge, or stair shape.

native.behavior: Raise a seven-by-three solid, 40-HP stone panel for fifteen seconds.
native.adaptation: One rectangular entity collision panel replaces arbitrary permanent stone terrain; finite durability/lifetime, occupied placement rejected and no block drops. It also blocks native sight targeting.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Forms an opaque ice barrier; shattered sections can leave a hazardous frozen passage.

native.behavior: Raise a five-by-three wall of individually breakable ice blocks, lifting occupants as rows emerge in a frost burst. After ten seconds, surviving conjured blocks sink and shatter.
native.adaptation: A temporary one-block-thick wall replaces the former HP slab and fracture damage. Width scales with area up to nine blocks; loaded supported air cells and safe lifting headroom are required. Broken or replaced cells permanently lose ownership; expiry, dispel and unload preserve player replacements. Conjured ice yields no items or melting water.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Secrets of Magic errata 2.0 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: Raises a standing water barrier that affects fire, projectile passage, and creatures crossing it.

native.behavior: Raise a five-by-three traversable wall of real conjured water for ten seconds, extinguishing creatures and slowing physical projectiles in its cells.
native.adaptation: Water uses native water rendering and immersion physics, confined to owned cells rather than spreading source blocks. Supported loaded air is required; broken or replaced cells lose their claims. Expiry drains surviving water, preserving player replacements. No harvested water; native spell projectiles bypass the additional drag.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Projects a stationary object's appearance, with richer sensory detail available at higher ranks.

native.behavior: Show a stationary, non-solid object silhouette for ten seconds.
native.adaptation: An original translucent crate-sized preset replaces unrestricted object modeling; collision and resources stay unchanged and an attack removes the fragile image.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: A reaction substitutes a wooden decoy for a critical hit while the caster steps aside.

native.behavior: The first hit of at least eight HP sheds up to six HP and attempts a safe sideways step.
native.adaptation: Automatic finite interception replaces a chosen reaction and critical-hit trigger. Overflow remains; failed relocation never grants extra mitigation.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: Grows a tree that intercepts attacks against nearby allies, consuming its own health first.

native.behavior: Grow an oak tree from real temporary logs and leaves. Its sixteen-HP pool protects three consenting adjacent allies for ten seconds.
native.adaptation: Loaded supported air and room for the entire canopy are required. Recipients are captured on placement and must stay within three blocks. Each missing trunk removes a quarter of the maximum protection; damage spends the shared pool. Only surviving owned blocks retract at expiry; edits, replacements and holes are preserved. No log or leaf loot.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: Repositions several creatures within a local area; unwilling targets can resist.

native.behavior: Move three willing nearby allies into a supported formation at the aimed destination.
native.adaptation: Automatic fixed formation replaces independently chosen destinations. Every destination validates before any creature moves; players opt in through the development consent control.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: A reactive gust carries the caster away from a newly adjacent creature.

native.behavior: The first enemy entering a two-block boundary triggers a safe three-block retreat away from it.
native.adaptation: Finite proximity entry replaces a chosen reaction; no damage immunity and an obstructed retreat keeps the effect waiting until expiry.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Links an ally's life to the caster, splitting incoming injury while the pair remain close.

native.behavior: Transfer half an ally’s incoming damage to yourself, up to eight actual HP total, while preserving one HP.
native.adaptation: Only actual caster health/absorption loss reduces the original pending hit. Transfer cannot recursively transfer again; same dimension, consent and distance required.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Perceives invisible creatures and nearby phased spirits, and helps the caster recognize illusions.

native.behavior: Privately outline nearby invisible creatures for ten seconds.
native.adaptation: Caster-only silhouettes replace tabletop concealed checks; no invisibility removal or public glowing. Native perception boundaries still apply.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Rage of Elements errata 2.0 (2024-05-17)
source.summary: Sustains movable rain that hinders movement and can turn into damaging, slowing sleet.

native.behavior: An eight-second rain patch makes moving grounded creatures slide and obscures native perception across its edge.
native.adaptation: A velocity traction approximation and scoped creature rendering replace general weather, tabletop concealment and all block visibility; no terrain freezing or damage.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Calls a plant or fungal creature to fight while the spell is sustained.

native.behavior: Summon a stationary healing plant with six shared healing HP, or a fungus with eight shared guard HP.
native.adaptation: Two original support presets replace a bestiary. No melee minion AI; actual healed HP spends the plant budget, and destruction/expiry ends support.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Calls a fey creature to fight while the spell is sustained.

native.behavior: A fragile fey support silhouette spends four tricks briefly slowing nearby enemies.
native.adaptation: A stationary four-use support role replaces bestiary selection, spell lists and independent initiative. No copied creature model or vex melee reskin.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Calls an elemental creature to fight while the spell is sustained.

native.behavior: Choose earth cover, air projectile drag, water firefighting or a fire-pressure body with twelve shared damage HP.
native.adaptation: Four original, stationary elemental roles replace full summoned creature stat blocks. Every mode shares native costs and lifetime/budget constraints; no bestiary or automatic source-rank scaling.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Produces drinkable water that eventually vanishes if unused.

native.behavior: Add one water layer to an aimed cauldron.
native.adaptation: A finite Minecraft utility volume replaces a gallon pool. Full cauldrons fail; no fluid source block, item duplication or damaging water attack.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Conjures a temporary, simple object from permitted materials without creating genuine valuables.

native.behavior: Assemble a temporary wooden cover, step or platform for twenty seconds.
native.adaptation: Finite presets replace arbitrary mundane objects. Geometry has collision and durability but produces no inventory items, containers or loot.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Grows a willing creature and its equipment, increasing melee reach and force with awkwardness.

native.behavior: Become physically one-and-a-half size for eight seconds, with one extra block of player reach.
native.adaptation: Actual synced body scale and explicit reach replace tabletop size categories and weapon damage bonuses; occupied growth is rejected.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Makes a willing creature and its equipment tiny, reducing its reach.

native.behavior: Become physically half size for eight seconds, with reduced player reach.
native.adaptation: Actual body clearance replaces tabletop Tiny rules. Expiry removes only its owned modifiers and searches above an obstructed restoring body; no stealth immunity.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Enables several creatures to breathe underwater for an extended period.

native.behavior: Give up to three willing nearby allies thirty seconds of Water Breathing.
native.adaptation: Finite group environmental adaptation replaces long tabletop duration. Vanilla status merging preserves longer external Water Breathing effects.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Lets a creature stand and travel across liquids while retaining the option to swim.

native.behavior: Stand and move on nearby water surfaces for eight seconds; crouch to enter the water.
native.adaptation: Shared client/server contact support replaces fluid collision hooks. It does not lift submerged bodies or provide airborne flight; source/flowing-water heights are sampled.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Gives a creature clinging hands and feet for climbing surfaces.

native.behavior: Climb when touching a wall for eight seconds; crouch to release the grip.
native.adaptation: Client/server wall-contact velocity replaces arbitrary surface adhesion and ceiling crawling; no general flight.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Opens a temporary tunnel through an eligible wall and expels occupants when it closes.

native.behavior: Open a two-high, three-deep ordinary-stone passage for twelve seconds, then restore unchanged air cells.
native.adaptation: Fixed tunnel geometry replaces arbitrary Pathfinder passage dimensions. Ores/containers are excluded; exit and permissions validate first, occupants move to a checked exit before restoration.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Reshapes an existing stone mass into a rough form, potentially unbalancing creatures standing on it.

native.behavior: Capture one ordinary stone cell; recast within five seconds to move it to a nearby empty destination.
native.adaptation: One permanent volume-conserving cell move replaces freeform reshaping. At most six blocks between ends; no ore, containers, drops, occupied destination or invented stone.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Disguises an object's apparent condition as pristine or decrepit without repairing its actual state.

native.behavior: Overlay an illusory pristine-condition label and held-item glimmer for ten seconds.
native.adaptation: The initial native facade is a clearly labeled cosmetic tooltip/glimmer, not a full model replacement. Actual item identity, durability, enchantments and inventory data remain authoritative.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Suppresses a willing creature's sound and sound-dependent actions; higher ranks spread this into an aura.

native.behavior: Suppress positional sounds and explicitly vocal native delivery within a three-block region for eight seconds.
native.adaptation: Scoped sound emission/playback and an executable utterance gate replace tabletop verbal components. Existing ambient loops and non-native spell systems are outside the gate.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Core Rulebook errata 4.0 (2023-01-03)
source.summary: Creates consumable illusory duplicates that can divert incoming attacks away from the caster.

native.behavior: Three copies of the caster’s live model and equipment each absorb up to five HP of an eligible direct incoming attack.
native.adaptation: Finite deterministic mitigation replaces random target redirection. Projectiles, environmental fire and explosions bypass this initial direct-melee form; images do not block area damage.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Impossible Magic errata Summer 2026, 1st Printing (2026-07-30)
source.summary: Grants movement during a brief personal time stop, avoiding movement reactions but penalizing rapid reuse.

native.behavior: Briefly step out of time for one second, anchoring the body and suppressing attacks, uses and incoming damage.
native.adaptation: A bounded one-second absence replaces advancing the whole world’s time. No global time stop, movement during absence, resource regeneration or guaranteed tabletop action economy.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: Pulls creatures and unsecured objects toward a central point, with resistance and collision limits.

native.behavior: Collapse the formation of at most four enemies toward one aimed anchor with a single inward impulse.
native.adaptation: One zero-damage native impulse replaces Reflex saves and forced grid distance; no persistent vortex or repeating damage.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Creates an aura that hinders or prevents creatures voluntarily approaching the caster.

native.behavior: A six-second boundary rejects enemies crossing inward, while allies and outgoing movement pass.
native.adaptation: A stationary boundary replaces save-based aura movement restrictions. Creatures already inside remain; ranged attacks pass. Position changes crossing the sampled boundary are rejected at the next tick.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core 2 errata 1.1 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: Encloses one creature in a stationary, destructible force field that blocks passage and outside effects.

native.behavior: Enclose the aimed enemy within a two-way movement boundary for five seconds; outside hits spend a shared sixteen-HP pool.
native.adaptation: Movement boundary and finite outside-attack durability replace an invulnerable tabletop sphere. It is traversable after breaking; inside attacks and terrain are not blocked.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Secrets of Magic errata 2.0 (2024-12-16)
source.summary: Draws small metal objects to the caster or a lodestone, with resistance for secured possessions.

native.behavior: Pull up to eight nearby loose metal stacks toward your hand.
native.adaptation: A concrete ingot/nugget/raw-metal whitelist replaces arbitrary metal-material rules. Existing item entities/stacks remain intact; no equipped-item theft or copying.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Shelters a willing companion in a private extradimensional space, then returns it safely when the spell ends.

native.behavior: Shelter your existing tame companion for ten seconds, returning the same UUID and inventory afterward.
native.adaptation: Owned non-riding, non-leashed companions only. Uses an isolated private-dimension cell and persistent emergency-return journal; an unavailable private world rejects the cast.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Creates a stationary remote viewpoint through which the caster sees using their ordinary visual senses.

native.behavior: See through a stationary sensor up to twenty blocks away for eight seconds; damage immediately ends the view.
native.adaptation: Client camera changes while the server body stays vulnerable. Fixed sensor facing and normal tracked chunks replace arbitrary remote locations/panning; casting and interaction are blocked while viewing.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Maintains awareness of a willing living ally's direction, distance, and conditions on the same plane.

native.behavior: Privately monitor three consenting nearby allies’ coarse health, affliction count, distance and direction for fifteen seconds.
native.adaptation: Recipients captured at cast time; same-world loaded bodies only. No through-boundary public glowing, exact private health display or universal creature tracking.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: A reaction supplies breathable air when a creature enters an environment where it cannot breathe.

native.behavior: Breathe through water or suffocation until safe air resumes, with a five-second maximum.
native.adaptation: A self-cast conditional rescue replaces a reaction targeting another creature. Only drowning/suffocation is prevented; ordinary attacks are unaffected.

source.revision: aon-2026-10-01; Player Core errata Spring 2026, 1st Printing (2026-02-06)
source.summary: Creates a traversable privacy boundary that blocks outside perception and magical observation, and protects sleep.

native.behavior: A traversable ten-second bubble conceals creatures across its edge from native targeting and rendering.
native.adaptation: Scoped creature privacy replaces universal sound, weather, scrying and shelter rules. No damage prevention, solid wall, private-room teleport or general sleep guarantee.

excluded_overlap.reason: A generic Blindness volume would repeat existing control fields. Revisit only with actual visibility/light-volume behavior.
Clairvoyance supplies the first remote-camera design; a mobile reconnaissance sensor can follow once stationary camera ownership is solved.
An existing native example already provides its one-hit ward. Directional cover is an upgrade to that identity, not another count-padding entry.
The implemented64 Pathfinder spells and110 Iron adaptations already cover many basic attacks. New names/colors alone do not warrant more native spells.
